sources.title: Run the AI Coding Agent from Your Terminal - Kilo Code CLI
sources.keyClaim: kilo run --auto runs non-interactive autonomous mode; kilo serve/acp for headless servers; permission config gates auto-approval

sources.title: CLI | OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: opencode run --auto non-interactive; --format json; --attach to warm serve; acp for stdin/stdout nd-JSON

sources.title: Server | OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: opencode serve exposes OpenAPI 3.1 at /doc; POST /session/:id/message (blocking) and /prompt_async; GET /event SSE; OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD for auth

sources.title: Providers | OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: Providers are LLM API backends configured via provider block + models.dev; custom models via provider.<id>.models

sources.title: Config | OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: model/provider/mcp/permission/instructions schema; permission allow/ask/deny with wildcard patterns; {env:VAR} only in trusted config

sources.title: Kilo - Open Source Agentic CLI
sources.keyClaim: Headless & CI-ready: run non-interactively for scheduled refactors, PR triage, gated checks with scoped permissions

sources.title: Claude Code in CI/CD and Headless Automation
sources.keyClaim: Headless (-p/print) mode transforms CI into autonomous dev assistant; pattern transferable to Kilo/OpenCode

sources.title: Run Kiro CLI programmatically: introducing headless mode
sources.keyClaim: --no-interactive prints response to stdout and exits; used from GitHub Actions

sources.title: Agent hangs indefinitely when using opencode serve + client
sources.keyClaim: serve + client can enter infinite processing loop; prefer run for unattended jobs

sources.title: How Coding Agents Actually Work: Inside OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: Agentic loop: planning, tool calls, file I/O, shell exec; TUI is one client of a server
